learning_outcomes.text: Learns the basic concepts and design philosophy in mechatronic systems.
Gets familiarized with the basic actuators and sensors used in mechatronic systems.
Gains the ability to model and control mechatronic systems.
Has knowledge about industrial and military applications on mechatronics.

syllabus_topics: Mechatronic Design Philosopy and Sample Mechatronic Systems
Mechatronic Design Philosopy and Sample Mechatronic Systems
Design of Hydraulic and Pneumatic Actuators
Sensors and Transducers in Mechatronic Systems (including Piezoelectric Sensors, Shape Memory Alloys, and Micro Electro-mechanical Systems)
Sensors and Transducers in Mechatronic Systems (including Piezoelectric Sensors, Shape Memory Alloys, and Micro Electro-mechanical Systems)
Modeling of Mechatronic Systems based on Principles of the System Dynamics
Softwares used in the Modeling and Control of Mechatronic Systems
Project Delivery, Softwares used in the Modeling and Control of Mechatronic Systems
bibliography: J. Billingsley, Essentials of Mechatronics, Publisher: Wiley, 2005. N.P. Mahalik, Mechatronics: Principles, concepts and applications, Publisher: Tata McGraw-Hill, 2010. C. W. De Silva, Mechatronics: An Integrated Approach, Publisher: CRC.
M. Jouaneh, Fundamentals of Mechatronics, New Edition, Publisher: CL Engineering, 2012.
